description: This file defines the ApiService class responsible for managing HTTP communications with a backend server for a financial tracker frontend application. It includes methods for user authentication (login, register), transaction management (add, edit), and budget management (add, edit), utilizing the http package for network requests and shared_preferences for token storage.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to interact with backend API endpoints related to user authentication, transactions, and budgets.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returning an access token if successful.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a new transaction record to the backend.

methods.name: editTransaction
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction identified by its ID.

methods.name: addBudget
methods.description: Adds a new budget category with a specified limit.
